package handlers_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	studenthttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/student"
	apiv1 "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/nextbestaction"
)

type nextActionGetterStub struct {
	action    domain.TeacherNextAction
	err       error
	studentID string
	calls     int
}

func (stub *nextActionGetterStub) Execute(_ context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherNextAction, error) {
	stub.calls++
	stub.studentID = studentID
	return stub.action, stub.err
}

func TestNextBestActionHTTPUsesAuthenticatedStudentAndExactNextDTO(t *testing.T) {
	getter := &nextActionGetterStub{action: validNextAction()}
	response := serveNextAction(getter, "", "STUDENT")
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, response.Code)
	require.Equal(t, "no-store", response.Header().Get("Cache-Control"))
	require.Equal(t, "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", getter.studentID)
	expected, _ := json.Marshal(validNextAction())
	require.JSONEq(t, string(expected), response.Body.String())
	require.NotContains(t, response.Body.String(), "execution_id")
	require.NotContains(t, response.Body.String(), "handoff_id")
}

func TestNextBestActionHTTPErrorContractAndRolePolicy(t *testing.T) {
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name   string
		err    error
		role   string
		status int
		body   string
	}{
		{name: "disabled", err: domain.ErrNextBestActionDisabled, role: "STUDENT", status: http.StatusNotFound, body: "not found"},
		{name: "not ready", err: domain.ErrNextBestActionNotReady, role: "STUDENT_PRO", status: http.StatusConflict, body: "nba_not_ready"},
		{name: "owner unavailable", err: domain.ErrNextBestActionStateUnavailable, role: "STUDENT", status: http.StatusServiceUnavailable, body: "nba_state_unavailable"},
		{name: "unexpected", err: errors.New("boom"), role: "STUDENT", status: http.StatusInternalServerError, body: "failed to resolve next action"},
		{name: "wrong role", role: "ADMIN", status: http.StatusForbidden, body: "forbidden"},
		{name: "missing actor", status: http.StatusUnauthorized, body: "unauthorized"},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			getter := &nextActionGetterStub{err: testCase.err}
			response := serveNextAction(getter, "", testCase.role)
			require.Equal(t, testCase.status, response.Code)
			require.Contains(t, response.Body.String(), testCase.body)
			if testCase.role == "ADMIN" || testCase.role == "" {
				require.Zero(t, getter.calls)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestNextBestActionHTTPRejectsEveryQueryWithoutOwnerCall(t *testing.T) {
	getter := &nextActionGetterStub{action: validNextAction()}
	response := serveNextAction(getter, "?learning_path_id=22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "STUDENT")
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusBadRequest, response.Code)
	require.Zero(t, getter.calls)
}

func TestNextBestActionHTTPMapsEmptyOwnerItemsToStateUnavailable(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{
			"schema":"student-learning-workspace.v1","context_version":3,
			"selected_path":{
				"learning_path_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
				"course_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
				"status":"ACTIVE","path_version":4,"items":[]
			}
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, LearningWorkspaceToken: "teacher-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	response := serveNextAction(nextbestaction.Get{Enabled: true, Actions: client}, "", "STUDENT")
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, response.Code)
	require.JSONEq(t, `{"error":"nba_state_unavailable"}`, response.Body.String())
}

func serveNextAction(getter interface {
	Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherNextAction, error)
}, query, role string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	api := apiv1.NewRouter(
		&handlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{}, &handlers.TeacherDialogHandler{}, nil, nil, nil, nil,
		&handlers.NextBestActionHandler{Getter: getter},
	)
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Use(middleware.AuthMiddleware)
	router.Mount("/", api)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/teacher/me/next-action"+query, nil)
	if role != "" {
		request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
		request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", role)
	}
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	return response
}

func validNextAction() domain.TeacherNextAction {
	return domain.TeacherNextAction{Schema: domain.TeacherNextActionSchemaVersion, PolicyVersion: domain.TeacherNextActionPolicyVersion, Status: "READY", Primary: &domain.NextActionChoice{Kind: "START_LESSON", Target: domain.NextActionTarget{LearningPathID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", LessonID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"}}, SecondaryActions: []domain.NextActionChoice{}, ReasonCode: "start_ready_lesson", SourceVersions: domain.TeacherNextActionSourceVersions{ContextVersion: 3, PathVersion: 4, StateDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}}
}
